releases.name: Hatchling Icarus v1.1.0
releases.body:
Changed entire logic of how the mod actually affects the player to be cleaner, hopefully resolving a number of issues
-NRE when exiting to the main menu (for sure fixed)
-Personal field affecting certain physics objects, like Slate's Shipyard ships (hopefully fixed)
releases.bodyZh:
已更改模组实际影响玩家的整个逻辑，使其更清晰，希望能解决一些问题
-退出到主菜单时出现NRE（已确定修复）
-个人领域影响某些物理对象，如斯莱特的造船厂飞船（希望能修复）
